name: Ladiesthor
source: An invader from another world. He is born from a human mother and a demon. Because he was born with the human appearance, he was almost killed off. But thanks to his magical powers inherited from his mother, he was raised as a magician instead. However, he continued to be persecuted by the demons, and his mother also went insane from stress and committed suicide. Still, he became a skilled magician and was entrusted with a unit of demons. Yet, his hatred for the demonkind has not yet to be sated.
